user.title: Get your own data
user.intro: One ZIP file with what is stored about you. You have the right of access and to take your data with you (GDPR articles 15 and 20), whatever your role.
user.included: Your time entries and timers, your absence and leave, your timesheets with approval history, tasks you have created or been assigned, your comments, your profile and your settings. The names of the clients and projects your entries belong to are included as a reference.
user.notIncluded: Colleagues' data, clients' details, invoices and the organisation's setup. Hourly rates, amounts and cost prices are only included for owners and administrators, because they are the organisation's business data. Access keys and passwords are not included either.
user.scopeOrg: The file only covers your data in the organisation {org}, because each organisation is the data controller for its own data.
user.scopeSeveral: If you are in several, switch organisation in the menu and request again.
user.buildNote: {brand} builds the file in the background and emails you a link. The link works for 7 days and only for you, and then the file is deleted.
user.recentHeading: Your recent exports of your own data
user.unavailable: The full export is not available in this version yet. Use the data download on the GDPR page under Settings, or write to us if you need your data now.

org.intro: One ZIP file with everything, ready to keep or move to another system.
org.adminOnly: Only owners and administrators can get the whole organisation's data. You can get your own data in the card above.
org.unavailable: The full export is not available in this version yet. Use "Export data" below to get individual data types, or write to us if you need everything at once.
org.included: Time entries for all users, clients, projects, tasks, prepaid packages and usage, invoices and invoice basis, absence, timesheets with approval history, the event log, settings and attached files.
org.fileCsv: csv/ with one file per table for Excel
org.buildNote: {brand} builds the file in the background and emails you a link. The link works for 7 days, and then the file is deleted. Access keys and passwords are not included.
